name: @earendil-works/pi-gui
description: Electron and Vue desktop client for Pi
author: Aniao

scripts.check: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && biome check --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:format && npm run check:types
scripts.check:types: node scripts/prepare-ui.mjs && tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsgo --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer-test.json
scripts.package:dir: node scripts/prepare-default-provider.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: node scripts/prepare-default-provider.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: node scripts/prepare-default-provider.mjs && node scripts/prepare-linux-native.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux deb --x64 --publish never
